lines: Ravikumar Krishnamurthi, Promoter Group, holds 15,000 shares, valued at up to ₹1,352 each, about ₹2.03 crore, not selling in the offer.
Pre-Offer shares unlocked on 9 Sep 2026, 66 days ago, a recent trigger worth raising while the holding is still unsold.
Confidence is medium: the holding appears in one section only, and the seller table does not list them.
Proceeds are not applicable as they are not in the seller table; the value shown is an estimate at offer price.
